metadata.title: SoftBank Stock Rides AI Wave to All-Time High

content.text:
Updated June 1, 2026 10:01am ET
SoftBank Stock Rides AI Wave to All-Time High
SoftBank, the global tech conglomerate riding high on AI, became Japan’s most valuable company today, as a jump in shares of 14% propelled it past long-dominant Toyota.
SoftBank stock is at an all-time high: It has gained 57% in the past month and nearly 350% in the past year, taking its market capitalization to about $305 billion, or 48.8 trillion yen, compared with Toyota’s 46 trillion yen, according to data provider FactSet.
That ends the carmaker’s 23-year reign atop Japan’s league table. (Excluding so-called treasury shares at the companies, SoftBank surpassed Toyota on market cap last week.)
